title: Structural and biochemical basis for the formation of alpha-(1-->3)-linked mannose residue in O-glycans of Saccharomyces cerevisiae.
authors: Hira, Daisuke; Kadooka, Chihiro; Oka, Takuji
one_liner_zh: 该文解析酵母O-聚糖α-1,3-甘露糖转移酶Mnt2p的晶体结构，并结合对接与分子动力学模拟阐明其底物特异性和连接选择性，虽以酶结构为核心，但涉及蛋白结构解析与计算模拟，对蛋白质结构计算研究有参考价值。
abstract: The biosynthesis of O-mannose-type glycans in the budding yeast Saccharomyces cerevisiae requires the sequential action of multiple mannosyltransferases. However, the molecular mechanism governing alpha-(1-->3)-linkage formation remains poorly understood. Mnt2p, a member of glycosyltransferase family 71 (GT71), catalyzes the transfer of the fourth and fifth mannose residues of O-glycans via alpha-(1-->3)-linkages. Here, we report the crystal structure of Mnt2p at 2.40 A resolution, representing the first experimentally determined structure of a GT71 family enzyme. The structure revealed an N-terminal domain adopting a canonical GT-A fold harboring a DXD motif that coordinates a Mn(2+) ion and a novel C-terminal domain unique to the GT71 family. The active site is formed at the interface between these two domains, and GDP-mannose binds to a cleft adjacent to the catalytic metal ion. Using recombinant Mnt2p expressed in Escherichia coli, we biochemically demonstrated its alpha-(1-->3)-mannosyltransferase activity and determined its substrate specificity toward alpha-mannobiose acceptors. Docking and molecular dynamics simulations revealed that the C-terminal domain forms the acceptor substrate-binding site, providing the structural basis for alpha-(1-->3)-linkage selectivity, distinct from the linkage specificity of alpha-(1-->2)-mannosyltransferases. These findings establish the structural foundation for understanding the differentiation of alpha-(1-->2) and alpha-(1-->3) mannosyl linkages in yeast O-glycan biosynthesis.
abstract_zh: 出芽酵母酿酒酵母中O-甘露糖型聚糖的生物合成需要多种甘露糖基转移酶的依次作用。然而，调控α-(1→3)-键形成的分子机制仍知之甚少。Mnt2p，作为糖基转移酶家族71（GT71）的成员，通过α-(1→3)-键催化O-聚糖第四和第五个甘露糖残基的转移。在此，我们报告了分辨率为2.40 Å的Mnt2p晶体结构，这是GT71家族酶的首个实验确定结构。该结构揭示了一个N端结构域，采用典型的GT-A折叠，包含一个协调Mn(2+)离子的DXD基序，以及一个GT71家族特有的新型C端结构域。活性位点形成于这两个结构域之间的界面，GDP-甘露糖结合在催化金属离子附近的裂隙中。利用在大肠杆菌中表达的重组Mnt2p，我们通过生化实验证明了其α-(1→3)-甘露糖基转移酶活性，并确定了其对α-甘露二糖受体的底物特异性。对接和分子动力学模拟揭示，C端结构域形成受体底物结合位点，为α-(1→3)-键选择性提供了结构基础，这与α-(1→2)-甘露糖基转移酶的键特异性不同。这些发现为理解酵母O-聚糖生物合成中α-(1→2)和α-(1→3)甘露糖基键的分化建立了结构基础。
